title: Energy-efficiency exemptions: identifying buildings and uses exempt from Section 9.36 and NECB
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023; printing not stated in document; also cites NECB 2020 (energy)
document_date: Date Issued: May 2025 (platform created May 27, 2025, last updated May 27, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation assists in identifying buildings and uses that are exempt from Section 9.36 Energy Efficiency, such as buildings constructed to shelter equipment.
The application of an exemption is based on use, occupancy and specific building types, and is determined on a case-by-case basis.
When requested, the designer must provide the AHJ sufficient information, including references to the energy code, showing why a building may be exempted.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
Joint NBC(AE)/NECB reference; NECB 2020 is cited but not in the package.
